summary: Full backend + frontend regression pass for ND Curtains after removal of Gallery/Testimonials, addition of WhyChooseUs, new logo, Resend email enable, and GA tag. 6/6 pytest backend tests pass. All frontend testids, sections, Why-Us cards/CTA, GA tag, empty-submit error toast, and full happy-path form submission (with backend persistence) all pass.
passed: POST /api/consultations valid payload -> 200, returns uuid id + ISO created_at
GET /api/consultations sorted by created_at desc, no _id leak
Resend email sends successfully (backend log: 'Notification email sent.') without breaking request
Home page loads with hero-section, curtain-canvas (WebGL), hero-title, hero-quote-btn, hero-draw-btn
Navbar links present: nav-link-about, nav-link-services, nav-link-why us
Sections present: about-section, services-section, why-us-section, quote-section, footer
WhyChooseUs heading 'Where luxury meets affordability.' + 4 cards (why-us-card-0..3) + why-us-cta all present
Google Analytics gtag script for G-D1LZR389FC present in <head>
Empty submit -> sonner error toast shown, no POST
Filled form (Custom Curtains) -> success toast, form resets, record persisted via GET /api/consultations
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: POST /api/consultations returns 200 instead of 201 for resource creation (not a bug, but non-idiomatic REST).
Minor: send_notification_email swallows exceptions silently (only logs). This is intentional so email failures don't break the request, but consider surfacing to observability.
seed_data_creation: Several TEST_/E2E_ prefixed consultations were POSTed during testing; not cleaned up (no DELETE endpoint exists).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_consultations.py. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. RESEND_API_KEY is configured and emails actually send in this env.
